title: Chapter 263 Looking Back
content:
Chapter 263 Looking Back

Mount Tai, above the clouds.

It's winter, everything is withered, and the cold wind kills.

The sky was filled with clouds and mists, and a layer of hoarfrost was condensed around the top of the mountain. It was crystal clear, and under the sunlight, it sparkled with sparkling waves, which was truly moving.

As far as the eye can see, there is a small pavilion on the top of the mountain. It is just a simple wooden building, but it can also shelter from the wind and rain, and it has exhausted its usefulness.

The breeze blows gently, and there are two figures sitting upright in the pavilion. At this moment, they are blown by the breeze, causing them to feel fluttering, matching the surrounding clouds and mist, and the smoke from the tea brewing on the stone table in the pavilion. , really like a fairy, so unrestrained!

There were two people sitting in the pavilion, and one of them was wearing a purple-gold imperial robe. Various mysterious patterns were engraved on the imperial robe. Coupled with the mysterious man's calm and majestic temperament, although his face was calm and colorless, he still felt infinitely majestic. The other person is wearing a black warrior uniform, but the robe has no decoration at all, and his whole body is completely black, but from a distance, this ordinary person is wearing ordinary clothing, but he also has a sense of admiration!

The man in imperial robes held up a white porcelain cup with various patterns carved on it, so elegant and elegant. He took a sip of the tea lightly, and closed his eyes slightly, as if he was savoring the mellow aroma of the tea. Soon, the man's eyes opened, a flash of light flashed, but it was fleeting, his lips moved slightly, and said.

"Meng De, you and I have known each other for seven years! Just looking back on the past, I feel that it is just like yesterday, and all kinds of things in the past are still in my mind. It's just that time is like a torrent of rivers, and it is hard to return! "

Listening to the words of the man in imperial robes in front of him, this man named Meng De, who is the current Hussar General of the Yu Kingdom, Cao Cao who controls countless lives and deaths, also took a sip of tea, his eyes were slightly closed, and a smile appeared on his face. The color of memory.

After a while, I came back to my senses, and said with some emotion: "Yes, Your Majesty! Back then, when you met my minister, you were still in Luoyang Chaotang, and I saw you with my own eyes, gradually replacing the big man and becoming the A new master of this world!"

Listening to Cao Cao's words, the man in the imperial robe, Zhong Yu, the master of the Great Yu Empire, turned his head and looked at the rising sun with deep thoughts.

The time seems to have returned to seven years ago. At that time, he had just had an adventure for only three or four years, and everything was full of passion for him.

At that time, he was ambitious and tried to conquer everything.

At that time, he was ambitious and wanted to live forever.

At that time, he personally led an army of 100,000, stepped into Luoyang City arrogantly, and personally ended the Han Dynasty that had been passed down for four hundred years. After that, the ambitious South and North Wars seemed to be so insignificant in his eyes.

It was also at that moment that his heart completely changed.

"Yeah! I still remember, Aiqing, you were still a little cavalry captain at that time, and you could only stand in an inconspicuous corner in the back row among the lords, but your eyes exuded that kind of vigor , but overwhelmed everyone's demeanor!"

Cao Cao was a little emotional when he heard this.

At that time, he was only twenty-six or seventeen years old, and it was the time when he was full of vigor and heroic appearance. And what he has done at this age has attracted everyone's attention.

I still remember that in the majestic government office, there were majestic government servants standing neatly on both sides. They held the five-color sticks set by Cao Cao himself, and looked coldly at the man among them who was still full of arrogance.

And the person kneeling under the hall, who is being judged, is the uncle of the eunuch who has the most power in the court.

At a time when the expressions of officials were changing and everyone was afraid of those people who had no beard on their faces, this young man who was still young and full of fantasy in his mind bravely stood up and punished this person who violated the law. due judgment.

I still remember that when the world was in chaos, ants wearing yellow scarves swarmed everywhere, stirring up the whole big man into a pot of porridge. It was also at this moment that this young man stepped forward and led the elite soldiers and generals under his command to conquer the north and the south and made great achievements in battle.

The most unforgettable thing is that this young man, leading the elite soldiers of thousands of horses, solemnly took over the soldier talisman from the person in front of him on the general platform. Afterwards, he crossed the Great Wall without hesitation, left the frontier, imitated Wei Huo in ancient times, chased death and chased the north, and once again set up a mighty army for the son of the Han family.

"Your Majesty may not know it yet, but when I first met you, I still had in my heart the idea of imitating Jing Ke and eradicating a powerful enemy for me! It's just..."

Having said that, Cao Cao didn't say any more, picked up the teacup in his hand, and drank it down in one gulp.

"Hehe! Yes, I'm afraid in your hearts, as long as you don't have me, the big man can be restored at any time, and the world can restore peace again!" After saying these words lightly, Zhong Yu's face was a little bit pale. Smile.

"What your majesty said is true. This is what I thought at the beginning. Now that I think about it carefully, I find it ridiculous. Now I feel a little ashamed! But fortunately, I didn't put it into action, so I was able to follow your majesty. Seeing such a Scenery!" Cao Cao laughed a few times, and he was really glad that he didn't do anything stupid. Otherwise, his current fate might be the same as that Jiangdong tiger, Sun Jian whom I admired and admired so much at the beginning, right?

How can it be like this, following His Majesty to fight in the heavens, seeing the demeanor of one world after another, and appreciating one after another of the characters that exist in legends, it is enough to comfort one's life.

Afterwards, the two drank tea with each other, chatted about some past events, and sighed for a while.

A whole morning's work passed like this.

Zhong Yu got up, came to the eaves of the pavilion, stood with his hands behind his back, and watched the clouds rise and fall. Cao Cao also got up and stood around.

"Aiqing, I heard that you have been talking behind your back, saying that the king of a country must not be without heirs, and the head of a country must not be without heirs. You are very concerned about my private affairs!"

In the middle of the calm, this voice suddenly sounded, and Cao Cao, who was enjoying the beautiful scenery behind him, lost his mood in an instant, and was covered in cold sweat, terrified.

As a subject, it's wrong to talk about the emperor in private, let alone being discovered by his own emperor, and he raised it in person, how not to make people feel afraid and ashamed.

"Your Majesty, there is indeed such a thing. It is only against the way of people and ministers. I know that Your Majesty's destiny is long-lasting and eternal. However, the ministers are mortals after all. They have accepted since childhood that there are three ways to be unfilial, and that there are no descendants. It is common sense to have such worries!" Cao Cao's thoughts turned sharply, thousands of thoughts flooded his mind, but he answered truthfully in the end.

I carefully read what I wrote earlier, and found that it was horrible, and I couldn't stand it. Now I am going to try to change the style, it may be a bit abrupt and not mature enough, I hope everyone can understand. In the next chapter, the heroine will appear, everyone may wish to guess, who is it?
